texts: I'm a Finnish DevOps and Cloud engineer with a solid background in software engineering and cloud platform engineering.
I graduated from Metropolia University of Applied Sciences in 2019, and I've also got a triple degree as an ICT technician.
I have a great passion to create and learn new things, thus making this field particularly exciting.
At the moment I'm most interested in different Cloud infrastructures and services - mainly (but not limited to) AWS and Azure.
In my free time I love to do all kinds of music related things, play video games, go for a run, or to the gym.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Azure development, AWS infrastructure (CDK), Ansible, Kubernetes, SAP CC, AWS admin tasks, etc. Helping out an Ops team with automating the management of many Azure Windows VMs, developing a C# CLI tool for M-Files, and other tools for the team. Managing multiple projects' infrastructure, and more.

jobs.title: Cloud/DevOps engineer
jobs.description: AWS, DevOps, Kubernetes and Terraform development, on-premises to AWS migration, designing a category A2 certified AWS environment, cloud infrastructure design, monitoring, test automation, CI/CD, Robot Framework, etc.

jobs.title: Full stack developer
jobs.description: Developing a large distraint system (ULJAS) and related electronic services (ULSA), using Java and Angular, as a part of a SAFe scrum team. I did my bachelor's thesis as a part of this project.

jobs.title: System specialist
jobs.description: Server maintenance, GDPR related Linux server hardening (Bash), Python automation for the error log, 3rd line customer service.

jobs.title: IT support
jobs.description: Web site administration, AD configuration (Windows server), central radio system administration (Linux server), printer installations, email server administration, daycare software deployment and support (Tieto Effica), instructing trainees.
